defs.def: to take goods, letters, etc. to the person or people they have been sent to; to take sb somewhere 递送；传送；交付；运载

ex.s: Consider the best method to deliver your message.
ex.t: 考虑传递信息的最佳方法。

ex.s: Since early 2020, Ms Young has raised money to buy meals from Chinatown restaurants and deliver them to those in need.
ex.t: 自2020年初以来，杨女士一直在筹款购买唐人街餐厅的餐食并送给需要帮助的人。

ex.s: He used to go to the gym or library after delivering students to schools.
ex.t: 他过去常在送完学生去学校后去健身房或图书馆。

ex.s: Once the book you've requested is delivered to the nearest branch, they will inform you by e-mail, so you can pick it up.
ex.t: 一旦你借的书送到最近的分馆，他们会通过电子邮件通知你，这样你就可以去取了。

ex.s: I finally quit delivering newspapers and didn’t see Mrs Stanley for several years.
ex.t: 每当有人因为关心你而问候你的近况时——而不是因为他们拿了钱才这么做——你就会发现社区的存在。

defs.def: to give a speech, talk, etc. or other official statement 发表；宣布；发布

ex.s: In one area, a book reading was being delivered.
ex.t: 在一个区域，一场读书会正在举行。

ex.s: You might want to: • relax and make eye contact with the audience • use gestures when appropriate • vary your tone and volume 1 Select a representative from the group to deliver the speech to the class.
ex.t: 你或许想要：• 放松并与听众保持眼神交流 • 在适当的时候使用手势 • 变换你的语调和音量 1 从小组中选一名代表向全班发表演讲。

ex.s: Point of view Arguments Supporting examples Write your speech together and practise delivering it.
ex.t: 观点 论据 支撑例子 一起写下你的演讲并练习发表它。

defs.def: to do what you promised to do or what you are expected to do; to produce or provide what people expect you to 履行诺言；不负所望；兑现

ex.s: What help does Cruse offer after delivering students to schools? (no more than 12 words)
ex.t: 克鲁斯在送完学生去学校后提供什么帮助？（不超过12词）

ex.s: What if the only way of getting news from far away friends was writing letters that took ages to be delivered?
ex.t: 如果从遥远的朋友那里获得消息的唯一方法是写信，而这些信件需要很长时间才能送达，那该怎么办？

ex.s: PASS doesn’t re-teach or deliver new content.
ex.t: PASS不重新讲授或不传授新内容。

defs.def: to give sb/sth to sb else so that they are under this person's control 交出；交付；移交

ex.s: He was just saying: “I’m king of this forest, and here is your reminder!” Once his message was delivered, he allowed me    70    (stay) and watch.
ex.t: 它只是在说："我是这片森林之王，这是提醒你！"一旦传达完信息，它允许我____70____（stay）留下观察。

ex.s: This wealth of ways of sharing is a response to our increasing demand for quality goods and services at competitive prices, all delivered at the click of a button.
ex.t: 这种丰富的分享方式是对我们以具有竞争力的价格提供优质商品和服务日益增长的需求的回应，所有这些都只需点击一下按钮即可交付。

defs.def: to help a woman to give birth to a baby 助产；接生
to give birth to a baby 分娩；生孩子
to throw or aim sth 投掷；把 … 瞄准；用 … 对准
to rescue sb from sth bad 解救；拯救；使摆脱

chunks.cn: 递送用鼠标或在触控板
